title: Supply a default query
summary: NestJS: Supply a default query. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: DefaultValuePipe supplies a value before ParseIntPipe checks it. Open GET /page with no query.
learningObjectives: Supply a default query with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Supply a default query

blocks.text: The default pipe supplies 1 for the missing query input. The integer pipe then checks it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Pipe order matters: the default should happen before parsing.
